items.name: On-Time Project Delivery Rate
items.formula: `(Projects Delivered by NTP Deadline / Total Projects) * 100`
items.trigger: Drops below 80%: Audit lead times & CPM scheduling.

items.name: Labor Budget Variance (CPI)
items.formula: `Earned Technician Hours / Actual Technician Hours Spent`

items.name: Project Gross Profit Margin
items.formula: `((Final Invoiced Revenue - Total Direct Costs) / Revenue) * 100`
items.trigger: Drops below 28%: Audit estimating labor hours & waste.

items.name: Change-Order Capture Rate
items.formula: `(Billed Change Order Revenue / Total Unplanned Work) * 100`
items.trigger: < 85%: Technicians giving away work; enforce 4-sentence script.

items.name: First-Pass Inspection Rate
items.formula: `(Inspections Passed on 1st Attempt / Total AHJ Inspections) * 100`
items.trigger: < 80%: Mandatory internal 100% pre-test audit before AHJ walk.

items.name: Retention Collection Velocity
items.formula: `Average Calendar Days from Substantial Completion to Retention Cash`
items.trigger: > 45 Days: Audit closeout dossier delivery & punch clearance.

items.name: Punch-List Defect Density
items.trigger: > 3.0 Items: Enforce internal pre-walkdown before client walk.

items.name: Labor Rework Percentage
items.formula: `(Hours Spent Correcting Defects / Total Project Hours) * 100`
items.trigger: > 5.0%: Retrain crew on termination & pathway standards.

items.name: BOM Lead-Time Variance
items.formula: `Promised Distributor Ship Date - Actual Shop Receipt Date`
items.trigger: Lead time slip > 3 days: Re-route order or deploy loaners.

items.name: Unresolved Field Blockers
items.formula: `Number of Active Site Issues Open > 48 Hours`
items.trigger: Any blocker > 48h: Escalate directly to Company Owner.

items.name: Technician Billable Utilization
items.formula: `(Direct Billable Job Hours / Total Paid Hours) * 100`
items.trigger: < 75%: Too much unbilled shop travel or missing material runs.

items.name: Closeout Dossier Turnaround
items.formula: `Days from Commissioning to Complete O&M Package Delivery`
items.trigger: > 10 Days: Pre-build as-built drawings during trim-out phase.

items.name: Bid Win Rate on Qualified RFPs
Safety Incident Frequency Rate
items.trigger: Any incident: Mandatory all-hands safety stand-down.

items.name: SLA Recurring Conversion Rate
items.formula: `(Completed Installs Converted to Annual SLA / Total Installs) * 100`
items.trigger: < 25%: Enforce delivering SLA proposal with final invoice.

items.name: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
items.trigger: < 4.0: PM and Owner conduct immediate client post-mortem.

items.name: Permit & JHA Compliance Rate
items.formula: `(High-Risk Tasks Started With Signed JHA + Permit / Total High-Risk Tasks Audited) * 100`
items.trigger: < 100%: Mandatory safety stand-down; foreman re-training on the six permit triggers.

items.name: Privacy & Hardening Sign-off Rate
items.formula: `(Systems Delivered With Signed Privacy Sheet + Hardening Certificate / Total Security Systems Delivered) * 100`
items.trigger: < 100%: Hold final delivery; audit the shop build baseline and credential management process.
